def: An API that keeps nothing between calls, so a conversation exists only because the client re-sends the whole message list each time.
Standing instructions placed outside the turn-by-turn messages that set the role, rules and style for a whole conversation.
The label on a message saying who spoke, normally user (everything coming in) or assistant (what the model said).
The field in a model response that says why generation ended, such as end_turn, max_tokens, stop_sequence or tool_use.
A required hard cap on how many tokens the model may generate in one response; reaching it truncates the output.
A sampling setting that divides the logits before the softmax, so low values concentrate probability on the top token and high values spread it out.
Sampling only from the smallest set of top tokens whose probabilities add up to p, after renormalising them.
A string that ends generation as soon as the model produces it, useful for preventing the model from inventing text such as a tool result.
A long-lived HTTP response in which the server writes named events as they happen, used to stream model output token by token.
Compiling a schema into a grammar and masking tokens that would break it at every step, so the output is always well-formed.
Model output in a machine-readable shape such as JSON matching a schema, obtained by prompting and validating, by a forced tool or by constrained decoding.
